description: Provenance: record carrying cascade:AIAsserted, content surfaced by a general-purpose AI assistant and not grounded in clinical sources (core v3.3)

input.exerciseFrequency: patient mentioned daily walks during ChatGPT conversation

notes: core v3.3 added cascade:AIAsserted (subClassOf cascade:ConsumerGenerated) for ungrounded general-AI content that must be evidence-checked before any reliance. It must never be confused with cascade:AIExtracted (clinically extracted) or cascade:EHRVerified. Carried here by a health:SocialHistoryRecord, whose shape does not constrain dataProvenance with an sh:in enum, so the AIAsserted leaf validates. Clinical record shapes (e.g. MedicationShape) deliberately exclude AIAsserted from their enum.
